protocol.training: staged; freeze both logistic branches before fitting output head
protocol.features: one common log10/minmax map to [-1,1], fitted to all 59 training rows
protocol.output: sigmoid(alpha dot [h1,h2,1]); combine probabilities, not logits
protocol.stage_settings: zero initialization, eta=1, 2000 full-batch mean-BCE updates each
protocol.scope: training demonstration; no held-out evaluation or probability-calibration claim

branch_I_vs_III.stopping_rule: fixed number of full-batch updates; no convergence claim

branch_I_vs_II.stopping_rule: fixed number of full-batch updates; no convergence claim

output_head.stopping_rule: fixed number of full-batch updates; no convergence claim

union_nonseparability_certificate.method: Explicit common point in the two convex hulls
union_nonseparability_certificate.claim: No affine threshold strictly separates all I from all II+III observations.
